title: UX Interaction Design Co-op – Summer 2027
note: Interaction design co-op on lift truck interfaces and warehouse apps; portfolio link required; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Summer co-op mentored by Crown's interaction design team.
facts.duties: Research user needs, field research, prototyping and testing new experiences, visual documentation for software and the design system.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in an associate or bachelor's program in Interaction Design, HCI, UX, Interactive Media or Visual Design; strong visual design; portfolio link with application. Crown does not sponsor; temporary-visa holders are not eligible.
